svg.title: Case 11: The invented racing hood
svg.desc: Two matched video frames at 2.875 seconds. A thin edge appears along the bottom of the recorded road. The generated frost scene shows a broad blue and pink striped hood. Qwen3-VL lists the added hood but awards 5 out of 5 for structure preservation.

g.text: A thin edge is visible at the bottom of the frame.
A broad striped hood fills the lower center.
Added object: “blue and pink striped hood of the car”
